title: Colossal Biosciences Reveals New AI Platform for De-Extinction
excerpt: Colossal Biosciences has launched an artificial intelligence platform to speed up its de-extinction projects, alongside a dedicated startup fund.
body_html:
Colossal Biosciences has introduced a new artificial intelligence platform designed to speed up its ongoing de-extinction initiatives. The technology aims to support the company's scientific goals by streamlining complex biological processes.

Alongside the platform launch, Peter Diamandis has established a new fund. This investment vehicle is created specifically to support startup companies that utilize the newly announced AI platform in their own work.
